degree_rationale: Why the Wheel and rains do not pierce the heavens but pass through them like a ship through lions of waves, like a bird through air. Illumines the non-cleaving passage-mechanism through analogies.
direction_rationale: Wisdom showing by image (ship-through-waves, bird-through-air) why cosmic motions don't damage their substrate.
grand_man_function: Spiritual passage-illumination — why heavens are not pierced.
title: Why rain does not pour all at once but mixes with elements
